patch.description:
Allowed transitions:

- PENDING_PAYMENT → CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, CANCELLED
- CONFIRMED → PROCESSING, SHIPPED, CANCELLED
- PROCESSING → SHIPPED, CANCELLED
- SHIPPED → DELIVERED, CANCELLED
- DELIVERED → REFUNDED
- CANCELLED and REFUNDED are terminal

Cancelling an order that has not yet shipped RESTORES its stock in the same transaction. Marking a cash-on-delivery order DELIVERED also settles its payment, because the courier collects on handover.

scope.description: What the image belongs to. It becomes a path segment in the stored key and is re-checked on attach, so a brand upload cannot be attached as a category banner.

variantId.description: Pin the image to one variant so the gallery can swap when a shopper picks that colour. Must belong to this product.

images.description: Attach several uploads in one call. Every image is validated before any row is written, so one bad key rejects the whole batch rather than leaving a half-attached gallery. Order is preserved.

imageIds.description: Every image id for this product, exactly once, in the order to display them. A partial list is rejected.

variantId.description: Send null to unpin the image from its variant.

parentId.description: Parent category — omit for a top-level category

imageUrl.description: Tile image shown on the storefront category grid. An https URL you already host — supply this OR `imageObjectKey`, never both. Send null to clear.

kind.description: CATEGORY_GRID and BRAND_STRIP are limited to one per store. PRODUCT_CAROUSEL may appear several times with different sources.

title.description: Defaults to a sensible name for the kind and source.

source.description: Which products a PRODUCT_CAROUSEL shows. Required for that kind, refused for the others.

sectionIds.description: Every section id, in the order they should appear on the homepage. A partial list is refused — it would scramble the sections it omits.
